🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S ECONOMY GREW 2.8% IN JUNE — EVERY SECTOR UP</u>

Mexico's economic activity rose 2.8% year-on-year in June (INEGI's IGAE), with all three sectors expanding: services +3.6%, industry +1.7%, primary +0.5%. As El Economista and El Financiero both report, this is the "stagnant, tariff-crushed" Mexico that US analysts keep forecasting — growing across the board through Trump's trade war.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO SHIPS "ZONA DIVAS" TRAFFICKER TO ARGENTINA</u>

After a seven-year court fight, Mexico extradited Raúl Luis Martins — a former Argentine intelligence agent and dual Argentine-Mexican national who ran the Zona Divas sex-trafficking ring from 2010 to 2019 — to face charges of human trafficking and money laundering in Buenos Aires. Arrested in Cancún in 2019, he stalled removal with amparo after amparo; the FGR beat them all back to put him on the plane.
banner: ZONA DIVAS BOSS EXTRADITED TO ARGENTINA

🇲🇽🏥 <u>FREE MEDICINE, HOME DELIVERED — NOW IN 24 STATES</u>

Mexico's Farmacias del Bienestar scales to 24 states and 6,567 distribution points by November — over 5,500 pharmacies plus 1,000 automated dispensers — building on a pilot that handed out 350,000 free medications in the State of Mexico. "The new phase begins in September and reaches national coverage in November," says Undersecretary Eduardo Clark. It runs alongside Salud Casa por Casa, which has logged nearly 25 million home visits since June 2025.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>WOMEN SUBSIDIZE MEXICO'S ECONOMY WITH 24% OF GDP — UNPAID</u>

In Mexico women perform 72.6% of all unpaid domestic and care work — labor worth 23.9% of GDP in 2024, per INEGI's satellite account. "The market is one of the principal beneficiaries of unpaid work," says Oxfam Mexico's Mariana Belló. The cost is measured in time: 63% of women live in time poverty, against just 7% of men.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S MINIMUM WAGE NOW BEATS INFORMAL PAY</u>

Banamex — a bank, not a leftist think tank — confirms Mexico's minimum wage now tops the median income of the entire informal sector. Since 2016 the minimum has multiplied 3.8x in nominal terms and gained 145% in real purchasing power per hour, with the sharpest jumps starting in 2019. Nine years of the 4T raising the floor, and the story now runs in La Jornada with the banks doing the math.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM: A MEXICAN PRESIDENT ANSWERS TO MEXICO — PERIOD</u>

Sheinbaum will send a constitutional reform to bar dual nationals from the presidency and state governorships: "A Mexican president is Mexican and does not represent another country," she said. The trigger is Tamaulipas ex-governor Francisco García Cabeza de Vaca — US-born, dual national — who has leaned on that second passport to fight extradition.

🇲🇽🍓 <u>Florida growers couldn't compete, so Washington slapped a tariff on Mexican strawberries</u>

The US Commerce Department set preliminary antidumping duties of up to 5.28% on Mexican strawberries after Florida producers filed the complaint. At stake: a one-billion-dollar export crop — 263,000 tons a year — grown by roughly 5,000 farmers, 97% of them on 10 hectares or less, and 151,000 jobs. Mexico's Economía Secretariat calls the 'winter strawberry' logic arbitrary and says it breaks both WTO rules and the very T-MEC Washington signed.
banner: US SLAPS TARIFF ON MEXICAN STRAWBERRIES

🇲🇽♿ <u>48,756 disabled Mexicans now get cash straight to their hands — no middlemen</u>

In the poorest edge of the State of Mexico, 48,756 people with permanent disabilities receive 3,300 pesos every two months, paid directly with no intermediaries skimming the top — part of a 75.8-billion-peso plan for the Oriente. Across the same region: 569,999 elderly pensions, 515,270 student scholarships, 39,707 women's stipends. The old system fed brokers; this one reaches families.

🇲🇽🩺 <u>Mexico's nurses have knocked on 25 million doors</u>

Since June 2025, the Salud Casa por Casa program — 20,000 nurses and health workers — has made nearly 25 million home visits to seniors and people with disabilities, run 17.1 million on-the-spot tests for glucose, cholesterol and triglycerides, and flagged 44,495 urgent cases straight to a hospital. Preventive healthcare that walks up to your door, at no cost.

🇲🇽🏙️ <u>Mexico City just opened its 8th 'Utopía' — public luxury for the working class</u>

For 52 million pesos, the México-Tenochtitlán center drops a mammography and mental-health clinic, a robotics lab and recording studio for kids, a rooftop farm, and 20 liters of clean water for 5 pesos into a single neighborhood. Named for the Aztec causeway and the youth murdered on June 10, 1971. Eight of these now, 315,000 square meters of it — the right to the city, built.
